title: RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
title_zh: RASteer：面向扩散模型概念擦除的保留感知激活引导

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model’s representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose R etain-aware A ctivation Steer ing ( RASteer ), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation. 1 1 1 Project page: https://rasteer.cvmlgroup.web.illinois.edu/
paragraphs.zh: 概念擦除旨在从预训练的文本到图像扩散模型中移除目标概念（例如受版权保护的风格、可识别的角色或不安全的内容），同时保留其生成其他内容的能力。 现有的激活引导方法主要通过目标概念构建擦除方向，并在推理时沿该方向调整模型激活值。 然而，目标概念与保留概念在模型的表示空间中常常存在重叠，因此这一方向也包含了保留概念所依赖的共享成分。 因此，直接沿此方向进行引导可能会抑制保留概念，并损害非目标内容的生成。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了无需训练的“保留感知激活引导”（RASteer）方法。 RASteer首先从需要保留的概念中构建一个保留子空间。 随后，“保留正交引导”（ROS）会移除擦除方向中与该子空间对齐的成分，使引导更专注于目标概念。 由于完全移除共享成分可能会削弱擦除效果，我们进一步引入了“重叠自适应校准”（OAC）。 在每一层和每次去噪步骤中，OAC利用擦除方向与保留子空间之间的重叠程度，来控制每个共享成分的移除量，从而在目标擦除与概念保留之间取得平衡。 在多个基础模型和基准数据集上针对不安全内容、实例和艺术风格的擦除实验表明，RASteer的表现与所评估的激活引导和权重编辑基线方法相当甚至更优，实现了擦除与保留之间的更佳平衡。1 1 1 项目页面：https://rasteer.cvmlgroup.web.illinois.edu/

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) are trained on web-scale data and inevitably learn content that their providers cannot include in their products, such as copyrighted artistic styles, recognizable characters, and unsafe images. When takedown requests, changes in regulations, or safety audits require removing such content, retraining on filtered data is too costly, while prompt- or output-level filters are easily bypassed ( Rando et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sarwar et al., 2026 ) . Concept erasure offers a practical alternative: it directly edits a released model to prevent it from generating a target concept ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and has become a key step in deploying T2I models responsibly. Such edits must erase the target while preserving all other content, including unrelated styles and characters, as well as open-domain generation.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型（Rombach 等人，2022）是在网络规模的数据上训练的，因此不可避免地会学习到其提供者无法包含在产品中的内容，例如受版权保护的艺术风格、可识别的角色以及不安全图像。 当删除请求、法规变更或安全审计要求移除此类内容时，使用过滤后的数据重新训练成本过高，而提示或输出层面的过滤器则容易被绕过（Rando 等人，2022；Zhang 等人，2026；Sarwar 等人，2026）。 概念擦除提供了一种实用的替代方案：它直接修改已发布的模型，以防止其生成目标概念（Gandikota 等人，2023；Kumari 等人，2023；Gandikota 等人，2024；Gong 等人，2024；Lu 等人，2024；Li 等人，2026），并已成为负责任部署 T2I 模型的关键步骤。 此类修改必须在擦除目标内容的同时保留所有其他内容，包括无关的风格和角色，以及开放领域的生成能力。

paragraphs.en: Existing erasure methods broadly fall into two categories: weight editing and activation steering. Weight editing fine-tunes the model or applies closed-form updates to its cross-attention matrices ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , writing these changes into model parameters and increasing the cost of switching or undoing edits. By contrast, activation steering ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ; Huu-Tien et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) keeps model weights fixed and suppresses target concepts by adjusting intermediate activations during inference, allowing edits to be enabled, disabled, or combined. The erasure direction is constructed from the target concept, and each image patch is gated based on its activation’s alignment with that direction.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的擦除方法大致分为两类：权重编辑和激活引导。 权重编辑通过微调模型或对交叉注意力矩阵应用闭式更新（Gandikota 等人，2023；Kumari 等人，2023；Gandikota 等人，2024；Gong 等人，2024；Lu 等人，2024；Li 等人，2026；Liu 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026），将这些修改写入模型参数，从而增加了切换或撤销编辑的成本。 相比之下，激活引导（Gaintseva 等人，2026；Huu-Tien 等人，2024；Xie 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024b）保持模型权重固定，通过在推理过程中调整中间激活值来抑制目标概念，从而允许对编辑进行启用、禁用或组合。 擦除方向由目标概念构建而成，每个图像块都根据其与该方向的激活对齐程度进行门控控制。

paragraphs.en: However, the target’s erasure direction may contain shared components that retained concepts also rely on, causing collateral damage. In the top row of Figure 1 a, steering along the original direction to erase Sonic turns the retained character Snoopy into an ordinary dog. Figure 1 b further shows overlap between the alignment scores of target and retained activations: at the default threshold, the gate incorrectly triggers on 65 % 65\% of retained activations and misses 21 % 21\% of target activations. Raising the threshold reduces false triggers but misses more target activations. In the bottom row of Figure 1 a, Snoopy remains recognizable after full projection even though it is the erasure target, showing that completely removing shared components can also weaken target erasure. These observations show the need to incorporate information about retained concepts into the erasure direction to reduce collateral damage and improve target erasure.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，目标对象的擦除方向可能包含共享成分，而保留的概念也依赖这些成分，从而造成附带损害。 在图 1a 的顶部一行中，沿原始方向进行引导以擦除索尼克，会使保留的角色史努比变成一只普通的狗。 图 1b 进一步显示了目标激活与保留激活的对齐分数之间的重叠：在默认阈值下，门控机制错误地触发了 65% 的保留激活，并漏掉了 21% 的目标激活。 提高阈值可以减少误触发，但会漏掉更多目标激活。 在图 1a 的底部一行中，尽管史努比是擦除目标，但在完全投影后它仍然具有可识别性，这表明完全移除共享成分也会削弱对目标对象的擦除效果。 这些观察结果表明，有必要将有关保留概念的信息纳入擦除方向，以减少附带损害并提高目标对象的擦除效果。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we propose R etain-aware A ctivation Steer ing ( RASteer ), which uses information about retained concepts to refine the erasure direction. It consists of two modules: Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) and Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). ROS constructs a retain subspace from the steering vectors of retained concepts. It identifies and reduces the shared components of the original erasure direction that align with this subspace, making the direction more specific to the target and reducing suppression of retained concepts. OAC adjusts the removal strength based on the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace at each layer and denoising step, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. As shown in Figure 1 c, RASteer further lowers target classification accuracy compared with full projection while maintaining similar accuracy on retained concepts, illustrating how adaptive calibration improves target erasure.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了“保留感知激活引导”（RASteer），该方法利用有关保留概念的信息来优化消除方向。 它由两个模块组成：保留正交引导（ROS）和重叠自适应校准（OAC）。 ROS 从保留概念的引导向量中构建一个保留子空间。 它能识别并减少原始消除方向中与该子空间对齐的共享成分，使方向更专注于目标，同时减少对保留概念的抑制。 OAC 根据每一层和每次去噪步骤中消除方向与保留子空间的重叠程度调整移除强度，从而在目标消除和概念保留之间取得平衡。 如图 1c 所示，与完全投影相比，RASteer 进一步降低了目标分类准确率，但对保留概念的准确率保持相近，这表明了自适应校准如何提升目标消除效果。

The results show that RASteer effectively suppresses target concepts while largely preserving retained concepts and general image quality, achieving a better trade-off between erasure and preservation. paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RASteer，这是一种闭式、无需训练的方法，通过引导交叉注意力激活来擦除概念，同时保持模型权重固定，且编辑过程可逆且可组合。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ROS to remove retain-subspace components from erasure directions and OAC to adjust removal strength at each layer based on erasure–retain overlap, without learnable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了 ROS，用于从擦除方向中移除保留子空间成分，并引入了 OAC，用于根据擦除与保留的重叠情况，在每一层调整移除强度，且无需任何可学习的参数。

paragraphs.en: Across unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure on multiple backbones and benchmarks, RASteer achieves the best erasure–preservation trade-off among the compared methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在多个基础模型和基准测试中，RASteer 在内容不安全、实例和艺术风格消除方面，相较于其他方法实现了最佳的消除与保留之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Model Editing for Concept Erasure. Fine-tuning methods suppress concepts by optimizing the denoiser ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) or training lightweight modules ( Lyu et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Closed-form methods directly update cross-attention weights: TIME ( Orgad et al., 2023 ) uses least-squares editing, UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) adds retention constraints, and RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) iteratively erases embeddings that regenerate the target. MACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) combines closed-form editing with LoRA fusion for mass erasure Hu et al. (2021) . SPEED ( Li et al., 2026 ) restricts updates to the null space of preserved concepts, while CURE ( Biswas et al., 2026 ) applies an energy-scaled spectral projection. These methods encode edits in model weights or trained modules, so switching or combining edits involves managing the corresponding parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 用于概念消除的模型编辑。 微调方法通过优化去噪器（Gandikota 等，2023；Kumari 等，2023；Zhang 等，2024a）或训练轻量级模块（Lyu 等，2024；Lee 等，2025；Huang 等，2024）来抑制概念。 闭式方法直接更新交叉注意力权重：TIME（Orgad 等，2023）使用最小二乘编辑，UCE（Gandikota 等，2024）添加保留约束，而 RECE（Gong 等，2024）则迭代消除会再生目标概念的嵌入。 MACE（Lu 等，2024）将闭式编辑与 LoRA 融合相结合，以实现大规模概念消除（Hu 等，2021）。 SPEED（Li 等，2026）将更新限制在保留概念的零空间中，而 CURE（Biswas 等，2026）则应用了能量缩放的光谱投影。 这些方法将编辑编码在模型权重或训练好的模块中，因此切换或组合编辑需要管理相应的参数。

paragraphs.en: Inference-Time Steering. The most recent family leaves the weights untouched and edits the generation process at inference: Safe Latent Diffusion ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) steers the sampling trajectory away from unsafe content through classifier-free guidance, SAFREE ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) projects prompt embeddings off the unsafe concept’s subspace in text-embedding space, SAeUron ( Cywiński and Deja, 2025 ) ablates sparse-autoencoder features of the target, and CASteer ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ) subtracts the target’s steering vector from cross-attention activations, keeping the edit reversible and composable. All of them, however, model only the concept to remove : none takes the concepts to keep as input, so a retained concept that shares directions with the target is suppressed along with it. RASteer keeps this weight-free runtime and supplies the missing ingredient: it builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve and steers only along the erasure direction orthogonal to it, with layerwise strength set by overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时引导。 最新的一系列方法保持权重不变，并在推理阶段对生成过程进行编辑：Safe Latent Diffusion（Schramowski 等人，2023）通过无分类器引导将采样轨迹引离不安全内容；SAFREE（Yoon 等人，2025）在文本嵌入空间中将提示嵌入投影到不安全概念子空间之外；SAeUron（Cywiński 和 Deja，2025）会抑制目标概念的稀疏自编码器特征；而 CASteer（Gaintseva 等人，2026）则从交叉注意力激活中减去目标的引导向量，从而确保编辑过程可逆且可组合。 然而，这些方法都只建模了要移除的概念：没有一种方法将需要保留的概念作为输入，因此与目标方向一致的保留概念也会一并被抑制。 RASteer 保持了这种无需修改权重的运行时特性，并补充了缺失的关键要素：它从需要保留的概念中构建一个保留子空间，仅沿着与该子空间正交的擦除方向进行引导，其各层的强度由重叠程度决定。

paragraphs.en: Sequential and Continual Unlearning. Continual learning studies how models acquire a sequence of tasks or concepts while mitigating interference with previously learned knowledge, whereas online learning emphasizes adaptation to a stream of incoming data or objectives Liu et al. (2020) ; Liu et al. (2021a) ; Liu et al. (2021b) ; Liu et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2023b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2019) ; Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Luo et al. (2023) ; Fischer et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023) . Sequential unlearning presents a complementary challenge: rather than continually acquiring new knowledge, a deployed model must continually satisfy new forgetting requests while retaining everything else Meng et al. (2022a) ; Meng et al. (2022b) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) . Repeated parameter editing can accumulate interference across requests, making preservation increasingly difficult. Our setting shares this continual adaptation perspective, but differs in that RASteer performs each edit at inference time without updating model parameters, allowing multiple erasure constraints to be introduced, removed, or combined without parameter drift.

paragraphs.en: Backbones and Benchmarks. We use Stable Diffusion v1.4 ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) as the main backbone and evaluate cross-model generality on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1, plus SDXL ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate unsafe content on I2P prompts ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , instances and artistic styles with matched retain concepts, and general open-domain generation on MS-COCO captions ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . We compare with SPM ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) , SAeUron ( Cywiński and Deja, 2025 ) , ESD-x/u ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) , MACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , and CASteer ( Gaintseva et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. RASteer is training-free and updates no weights. For each concept, we precompute its steering vectors offline and reuse them at inference. We steer every cross-attention layer with the OAC rule and no per-concept tuning. We use official code or released weights under default settings for every baseline. Experiments use NVIDIA A40. Appendix A.1 provides the complete implementation details.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 RASteer 无需训练，且不更新任何权重。 对于每个概念，我们离线预计算其转向向量，并在推理时重复使用这些向量。 我们使用 OAC 规则来引导每一层交叉注意力，且无需针对每个概念进行单独调整。 对于每个基线模型，我们都使用官方代码或默认设置下的已发布权重。 实验使用 NVIDIA A40 显卡。 附录 A.1 提供了完整的实现细节。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. We measure erasure and preservation jointly. Concept presence is scored by CLIP accuracy and CLIP score ( Radford et al., 2021 ) on the erasure target and on every retained concept. Unsafe content is counted by the exposed body parts detected with NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) . On COCO, CLIP score measures image–caption alignment, while FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measure distribution-level and paired-image drift from the unsteered backbone’s generations under the same prompts and seeds. For instance and style experiments, FID is computed against the corresponding unsteered concept generations.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们同时测量消除和保留情况。 概念存在性通过 CLIP 准确率和 CLIP 分数（Radford 等，2021）在消除目标以及每个保留概念上进行评分。 不安全内容通过 NudeNet（Bedapudi，2019）检测到的暴露身体部位进行统计。 在 COCO 数据集上，CLIP 分数衡量图像与配文的对齐程度，而 FID（Heusel 等，2017）和 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）则衡量分布层面以及配对图像相对于未引导主干模型在相同提示和种子下生成结果的偏移。 对于示例和风格实验，FID 是与相应的未引导概念生成结果进行比较计算的。

paragraphs.en: Erasure of Unsafe Content. On I2P, RASteer reduces exposed-body-part detections from 612 to 13, compared with 24 for CASteer and 83 for RECE. Table 1 provides the breakdown by body-part category. This setting is particularly challenging because the I2P prompts often invoke unsafe content without naming it directly. Prompt-triggered methods such as SPM therefore erase very little, while the weight-editing baselines reduce unsafe content but retain substantially more residual detections. Together with the COCO results below, these counts show that RASteer improves unsafe-content suppression while preserving general generation ability.

paragraphs.en: Preservation of General Content. Table 2 shows that the stronger erasure of RASteer does not come from globally degrading the model. paragraphs.en: Erasure of Instances. Table 3 evaluates sequential erasure while retaining the remaining characters. RASteer produces lower erased-character accuracy than CASteer throughout, while keeping the retained characters close to the unedited reference in both recognition and FID. The same pattern holds as sequential erasure progresses: target recognition continues to fall, whereas the remaining character stays recognizable and undergoes substantially less distributional drift than with CASteer. Several weight-editing methods can erase individual targets strongly, but their retained characters degrade more noticeably; conversely, methods that preserve the retained set most closely tend to leave the targets recognizable. The consistent improvement over CASteer on both sides shows that better target erasure does not come at the expense of related retained concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 实例擦除。 表3评估了保留其余字符的同时进行顺序擦除的效果。 RASteer在整个过程中产生的已擦除字符的准确率低于CASteer，但保留的字符在识别和FID方面都更接近未编辑的参考文本。 随着顺序擦除的推进，同样的模式依然存在：目标识别持续下降，而其余字符仍然可被识别，并且其分布漂移远小于CASteer的情况。 多种权重编辑方法能够强效擦除单个目标，但其保留的字符退化更为明显；相反，那些最紧密保留保留集的方法，往往能让目标保持可识别状态。 在两个方面均优于CASteer的一致性表现表明，更有效的目标擦除并不会以牺牲相关保留概念为代价。

paragraphs.en: Erasure of Artistic Styles. For styles, RASteer likewise produces lower target accuracy than CASteer across the evaluated blocks. It also reduces retained-concept FID throughout the style evaluation, while retained accuracy is improved or essentially unchanged. The preservation difference is particularly visible when erasing Rembrandt: CASteer substantially disturbs the related Van Gogh and Picasso styles, whereas RASteer keeps both much closer to their original distributions without sacrificing target removal. This task is a demanding test of selectivity because artistic styles share composition, texture, and color statistics. The consistent gain suggests that removing retain-aligned components prevents these shared visual properties from being mistaken for evidence of the target style. As in the instance results, methods with the smallest retain drift achieve it mainly through under-erasure, while RASteer maintains a stronger balance on both sides.
paragraphs.zh: 艺术风格的消除。 在风格方面，RASteer 在所有评估的图像块中产生的目标准确性也低于 CASteer。 它在整个风格评估过程中还降低了保留概念的 FID，而保留的准确性则得到提升或基本保持不变。 在消除伦勃朗风格时，这种保留差异尤为明显：CASteer 会显著干扰相关的梵高和毕加索风格，而 RASteer 则能更紧密地保持这两种风格的原始分布，同时不牺牲目标风格的去除效果。 这项任务是对选择性的严苛考验，因为艺术风格在构图、纹理和色彩统计特征上存在共享性。 这种持续的提升表明，移除与保留概念对齐的组件，可以防止这些共享的视觉特性被误认为是目标风格的证据。 与实例结果一致，保留漂移最小的方法主要通过过度消除来实现这一效果，而 RASteer 则在两个方面保持了更强的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Component Ablation. Table 4 uses the first block of Table 3 , erasing Snoopy and Van Gogh while treating the other concepts in their respective groups as retained concepts. All variants use the same vector configuration. Removing ROS recovers raw activation steering. Its retained-concept FID increases consistently, accompanied by lower recognition accuracy for several retained concepts, showing that ROS is responsible for limiting collateral changes. Removing OAC instead applies the full retain projection at every layer and step. For both erased concepts, this variant has higher target CLIP score and lower target FID, indicating that its outputs remain closer to the original target semantics and distribution. Van Gogh accuracy is an exception to this trend, so we interpret the erasure effect jointly through alignment and distributional change rather than accuracy alone. Together, the two ablations suggest complementary roles: ROS protects retained concepts, while OAC prevents the retain projection from removing too much of the target-specific erasure direction.
paragraphs.zh: 组件消融分析。 表4使用了表3的第一部分，移除了Snoopy和Van Gogh，同时将它们各自组中的其他概念视为保留概念。 所有变体都使用相同的向量配置。 移除ROS可恢复原始的激活引导。 其保留概念的FID持续上升，同时多个保留概念的识别准确率有所下降，这表明ROS负责限制附带变化。 移除OAC则会在每一层和每一步应用完整的保留投影。 对于这两个被移除的概念，该变体的目标CLIP得分更高、目标FID更低，说明其输出更接近原始目标语义和分布。 Van Gogh的准确率偏离了这一趋势，因此我们通过对齐和分布变化而非仅凭准确率来综合解释移除效应。 综合来看，这两种消融分析揭示了互补的作用：ROS保护保留概念，而OAC则防止保留投影过度去除目标特定的移除方向。

paragraphs.en: Cross-Attention Layer Scope. We compare five steering scopes with other settings fixed. Figure 5 a shows that Middle and High leave target CLIP accuracy above 96%, whereas Low reduces it to 10.8% for the instance and 35.8% for the style. Low+Mid matches All in target accuracy at 10.8% and 32.9%, respectively. Figure 5 b shows retained-concept accuracy above 98% across all scopes. paragraphs.en: We studied concept erasure through inference-time activation steering, where the target concept may share substantial representation with concepts that should be retained. We traced the collateral damage of raw steering to this overlap and proposed RASteer, a training-free method that leaves the model weights unchanged. Its ROS module removes retain-aligned components from the erasure direction, while OAC adjusts the removal strength according to the target–retain overlap. Across multiple concept-erasure benchmarks and four Stable Diffusion backbones, RASteer balances target suppression with preservation of retained concepts and general generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过推理时的激活引导研究了概念擦除问题，其中目标概念可能与应当保留的概念共享大量表征。 我们追踪到原始引导方法造成的附带损害源于这种重叠，并提出了 RASteer——一种无需训练、不改变模型权重的方法。 其 ROS 模块会从擦除方向中移除与保留概念对齐的成分，而 OAC 则根据目标与保留概念的重叠程度调整移除强度。 在多个概念擦除基准测试和四种 Stable Diffusion 基础模型上，RASteer 实现了目标抑制与保留概念及通用生成能力之间的平衡。

sents.zh: 我们通过推理时的激活引导研究了概念擦除问题，其中目标概念可能与应当保留的概念共享大量表征。

sents.en: Across multiple concept-erasure benchmarks and four Stable Diffusion backbones, RASteer balances target suppression with preservation of retained concepts and general generation.
sents.zh: 在多个概念擦除基准测试和四种 Stable Diffusion 基础模型上，RASteer 实现了目标抑制与保留概念及通用生成能力之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. First, our experiments focus on the Stable Diffusion family; extending RASteer to newer architectures such as diffusion transformers and FLUX remains future work. Second, RASteer relies on a predefined retain set, and poorly represented concepts may still be affected. Third, when the target direction overlaps substantially with the retain subspace, the direction available for erasure becomes limited, motivating adaptive retain-set construction or iterative steering.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 首先，我们的实验聚焦于 Stable Diffusion 系列模型；将 RASteer 扩展至扩散变换器（diffusion transformers）和 FLUX 等更新架构仍是未来的工作。 其次，RASteer 依赖一个预定义的保留集，而代表性不足的概念仍可能受到影响。 第三，当目标方向与保留子空间高度重叠时，可用于擦除的方向会变得有限，因此有必要构建自适应的保留集或采用迭代引导方法。

paragraphs.en: The erase–preserve pattern from the main results transfers across all three backbones. Relative to CASteer, RASteer generally lowers target accuracy while maintaining higher retained accuracy and lower retained FID on both instances and styles. The gains are largest on SD-1.x and narrower on SD-v2.1, where the targets are harder to suppress. On SDXL, the same retain-aware construction transfers to its dual text encoders and higher-resolution denoiser without changing the projection rule. Methods whose released implementations do not support SDXL are omitted rather than replaced by custom variants.
paragraphs.zh: 主结果中的“擦除–保留”模式在所有三种骨干网络中均保持一致。 与 CASteer 相比，RASteer 通常在保持更高保留准确率和更低保留 FID 的同时，降低了目标准确率，且这一效果在实例和风格两个维度上均成立。 在 SD-1.x 上的提升最为显著，而在 SD-v2.1 上则相对有限，因为后者中的目标更难抑制。 在 SDXL 上，相同的保留感知构建方式可迁移至其双文本编码器和更高分辨率的去噪器，而无需更改投影规则。 那些已发布的实现不支持 SDXL 的方法被省略，而非用自定义变体替代。

paragraphs.en: We analyze each row from left to right along two axes. Large deviations reveal collateral damage even when the erased target itself is absent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着两个轴，从左到右分析每一行。 对于被擦除的行，成功操作需要同时移除目标身份或风格，并用视觉上连贯的内容进行替换；可识别的史努比或梵高签名表明擦除不足，而重复的纹理、结构坍塌或空白场景则表明擦除过度。 对于保留的行，我们将身份、构图、颜色和纹理与第一列中的未编辑输出进行比较。 较大的偏差会暴露出附带损害，即使被擦除的目标本身并不存在。

paragraphs.en: Across SD-v1.4 and SD-v1.5, RASteer generally removes the target while producing structured alternatives, whereas several baselines either retain recognizable target cues or alter nearby concepts. SD-v2.1 is the more difficult regime: residual target cues occur more often, but the retained Mickey Mouse and Hokusai rows remain comparatively stable under RASteer. On SDXL, target removal is strong and the retained Pikachu and artistic-style rows expose the preservation advantage most clearly; the remaining texture changes in erased-style rows also show that strong erasure is not artifact-free. These recurring patterns match the quantitative erasure–preservation trade-off rather than relying on a single favorable sample.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SD-v1.4 和 SD-v1.5 中，RASteer 通常在生成结构化替代方案的同时移除目标，而一些基线模型要么保留可识别的目标线索，要么改变附近的概念。 SD-v2.1 是更具挑战性的环境：残留的目标线索出现得更频繁，但在 RASteer 处理下，保留的米老鼠和浮世绘大师 Hokusai 的行仍然相对稳定。 在 SDXL 上，目标移除效果显著，而保留的皮卡丘和艺术风格行最清晰地展现了保留优势；被擦除风格行中其余的纹理变化也表明，强效擦除并非完全没有伪影。 这些反复出现的模式与定量的擦除–保留权衡相符，而非依赖单个有利的样本。

paragraphs.en: A backbone-specific reading further separates the failure modes. On SD-v1.4 and SD-v1.5, incomplete instance erasure often leaves a recognizable silhouette, while stronger interventions can replace the entire subject or background. In the style rows, some methods suppress the named painter by flattening the image into repetitive texture rather than preserving the prompt content. SD-v2.1 shows the same effects more strongly: residual character shapes and dense repeated motifs coexist across methods. The SDXL rows make collateral damage especially easy to see because its unedited outputs are highly consistent; the retained Pikachu poses and wave-like compositions stay close under RASteer, whereas some baselines alter the subject, palette, or spatial structure. Thus the grid distinguishes successful semantic removal from mere visual degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 针对骨干网络的进一步分析揭示了不同的失效模式。 在 SD-v1.4 和 SD-v1.5 中，不完整的实例擦除通常会留下可识别的轮廓，而更强的干预手段则可能完全替换主体或背景。 在风格行中，某些方法通过将图像简化为重复的纹理来压制指定的画家，而非保留提示内容。 SD-v2.1 更明显地表现出相同的效果：残留的人物形状和密集的重复图案在不同方法中同时存在。 SDXL 的行列使附带损害尤为容易察觉，因为其未经编辑的输出高度一致；在 RASteer 下，保留的皮卡丘姿势和波浪状构图保持相近，而一些基线方法则改变了主体、调色板或空间结构。 因此，该网格能够区分成功的语义移除与单纯的视觉退化。
